anti_analysis: peb_beingdebugged_check: reads PEB via gs:[0x60] and tests the BeingDebugged byte at PEB+2; if a debugger is present WinMain returns 0 immediately without decrypting or loading the payload
encrypted_payload: the 32-byte payload in .data is only decrypted at runtime with a custom AES-SBOX cipher, hiding it from static string analysis

decoded_strings.decrypted_data_note: 32 pseudo-random bytes; not a valid PE image, so the reflective load attempt fails the MZ check at runtime (payload is placeholder/key material in this sample)

encryption_details.algorithm: Custom 16-byte block cipher, 10 rounds. Per byte, per round r (0..9): b = AES_SBOX[b] XOR key[i] XOR (27*r). Uses the standard AES substitution box (stored at VA 0x140005000) but is not full AES — a substitution-XOR construction. Applied to 16-byte blocks (function 0x140001480, block loop 0x140001530).
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded in plaintext in .rdata at VA 0x140005100; the 256-byte AES S-box table is at VA 0x140005000; encrypted 32-byte payload is in .data at VA 0x140004000

file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, mingw-w64/GCC 13 build, stripped

injection_details.dllmain_invocation: Walks the mapped image's export table comparing names with 'DllMain' (strcmp), then calls DllMain(base, DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH=1, NULL) via a register call
injection_details.method: Reflective DLL injection (manual in-memory PE mapping) using VirtualAlloc + memcpy of headers/sections + manual base relocation (IMAGE_REL_BASED_DIR64) + manual import resolution + call to the DllMain export
injection_details.note: The embedded payload is only 32 bytes and is not a valid PE, so the loader's MZ/PE validation fails at runtime; the injection machinery is present and exercised but no actual DLL is loaded in this sample
injection_details.payload_source: Embedded in the binary's .data section at VA 0x140004000 (32 bytes), encrypted with the custom AES-SBOX cipher; decrypted to a stack buffer in WinMain before being passed to the loader at 0x140001997
injection_details.payload_write: VirtualAlloc at the PE's preferred ImageBase (fallback: arbitrary base) with MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40); SizeOfHeaders copied, then each section copied to its virtual address
injection_details.target_discovery: N/A (self-injection; no process enumeration, no external target process)
